hints.title: Modular Arithmetic Accumulation
hints.text: Accumulate incoming path totals modulo 10^9 + 7 at each step.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from typing import List
from collections import defaultdict, deque

class Solution:
    def countRecoveryPathways(self, n: int, edges: List[List[int]]) -> int:
        MOD = 1_000_000_007
        adj = defaultdict(list)
        indegree = [0] * n
        for u, v in edges:
            adj[u].append(v)
            indegree[v] += 1
            
        dp = [0] * n
        dp[0] = 1
        queue = deque([i for i in range(n) if indegree[i] == 0])
        
        while queue:
            u = queue.popleft()
            for v in adj[u]:
                dp[v] = (dp[v] + dp[u]) % MOD
                indegree[v] -= 1
                if indegree[v] == 0:
                    queue.append(v)
                    
        return dp[n - 1]
```
